name: pam_tty_audit
detailed_description: Session module that enables Linux audit framework logging of terminal input and output. Particularly useful for auditing command execution on administrative accounts. Provides comprehensive terminal activity logging for compliance and security monitoring.

parameters.enable: Enable TTY auditing for specific users
parameters.disable: Disable TTY auditing for specific users

notes:
Enables Linux audit framework logging of terminal activity. Requires audit subsystem and auditd.
